label: PF Backlog 179
title: Knowledge standardization: agent-capabilities SSOT + knowledge_router unification + coverage
body: Unify the knowledge/skills front. (1) SSOT: config/agent-capabilities.json is the ONE role->knowledge/skills/domain/MCP binding; agent cards derive from it; DELETE the hardcoded agent_knowledge_map in agent_runner._load_knowledge_for_agent. (2) Delivery: route knowledge/skills through core/knowledge_router (by agent+stage) instead of ad-hoc directives. (3) One owner per area: docs/guidelines (domain knowledge), docs/tech-stack.json (chosen stack) + config/techstack-catalog.json, config/business-models-kb.json (business), pipeline/skills-registry.json (agent skills+MCP), core/reasoning_skills.py, core/service_catalog.py. (4) Namespace the three 'skills' (agent skills vs business skills vs skill_contracts). (5) Fill coverage: agent-capabilities for ALL pipeline agents (currently 13/24) + knowledge_layers on all cards (29/62). Document the map (reference doc + dashboard view).
_note: Loader now reads the SSOT (config/agent-capabilities.json 'knowledge' + card knowledge_layers, fallback hardcoded map); aliases names to docs/guidelines dirs; GuidelineContentLoader falls back to docs/guidelines/<layer>/*.md (dynamic layers); core/knowledge_registry resolve_layers merged. Verified: researcher knowledge 0 -> 12302 chars incl. Domain Research Guidelines.
